altitude.description: Altitude (m or ft, per units), 0 to 10000 m (32800 ft). Lowers the surface pressure the math adds to gauge readings. Default 0.

bleed_step.description: Gauge step the bleed pressure rounds down to (bar or psi). Default 5 bar (100 psi).

current.description: The cylinder now: analysed mix, gauge pressure and size.

cylinder_size.description: Metric: water volume of ONE cylinder in litres, the number stamped on the neck. Imperial: rated capacity in ft³ at rated_pressure (an AL80 is 77.4). Default: the preset's, else an AL80 (11.1 L).

oxygen_pct.description: Oxygen % of the gas in the cylinder now, as analysed, 0 to 100. Air is 21; an empty cylinder is 21 at pressure 0.

preset.description: A common cylinder instead of cylinder_size, as in plan_dive: al80, al40, al63, hp80, hp100, hp120, lp85, s80, single_10l, single_12l, single_15l, twin_10l, twin_12l, twin_15l, stage_11l, stage_7l, o2_3l, dil_3l. twin_ presets are a manifolded pair.

pressure.description: Gauge pressure now (bar or psi, per units), 0 to 500 bar (7252 psi).

rated_pressure.description: Imperial only: the psi the capacity is rated at. Default: the preset's, else 3000. Ignored on metric.

twinset.description: true for two cylinders on a manifold, filled or breathed together: doubles the volume. Default: the preset's, else false.

injection_order.description: Order the feeds join the intake: he_first (helium, then oxygen; the default) or o2_first. Picks which intermediate analyzer reading the text leads with; both are returned.

target.description: The mix and settled pressure to reach.

oxygen_pct.description: Target oxygen %, 0 to 100 (EANx32 is 32, trimix 21/35 is 21).

pressure.description: Target gauge pressure once the cylinder has cooled (bar or psi, per units).

units.description: metric (m, bar, L, °C) or imperial (ft, psi, ft³, °F): the unit system for every value in and out. Default metric.

name: blend_continuous

analyzer_final_pct.description: Oxygen % the analyzer reads on the finished stream.

analyzer_intermediate_he_first_pct.description: He first: oxygen % after helium joins the air, before oxygen.

analyzer_intermediate_o2_first_pct.description: O₂ first: oxygen % after oxygen joins the air, before helium.

bleed_pressure.description: Bleed the cylinder to this gauge pressure first; absent when no bleed is needed.

blend.description: The intake stream the whole fill must be.

ratios.description: Share of the intake flow per feed.

spoken_summary.description: A few plain sentences for a voice reply, ending with an offer: digits allowed, no symbols or notation.

units.description: metric (m, bar, L, °C) or imperial (ft, psi, ft³, °F): the unit system for every value in and out. Default metric.

title: Continuous-flow blend
